datasets: PARTY SPECIFIC IMPORTANCE ANNOTATION DATASET LEASE AGREEMENTS
outputs: Extractive summaries of obligations, entitlements, and prohibitions for specified parties in legal contracts

changes_made.explanation: Normalized model names to standard forms, removed redundant specifications, added missing baseline models mentioned in evaluation
Normalized ROUGE variants to base form as per guidelines
No LLMs were used as judges - ChatGPT mention was for exploratory analysis of the task, not evaluation

guideline: Legal experts rate summaries on 5-point scale for: informativeness, usefulness, accuracy of categorization, redundancy, accuracy of importance ranking; and overall quality on 10-point scale

changes_made.explanation: Guideline and criteria were correctly extracted and comprehensive

overall_notes: The extraction was generally accurate. Main improvements were normalizing model names to standard forms (e.g., BERT-base-uncased instead of BERT-BU) and consolidating ROUGE variants. The paper focuses on extractive summarization of legal contracts with strong human evaluation component.
